item.title: CFTC asks Novig and ProphetX to hold off listing sports micro and scorigami contracts, CryptoWeek reports — Oct 28, 2026 · 11:45 AM ET
item.description: - **CFTC asks Novig and ProphetX to hold off listing sports micro and scorigami contracts, CryptoWeek reports** — CryptoWeek reports the CFTC sent letters asking Novig and ProphetX not to list self-certified sports contracts and to explain why they comply with federal commodities law, with neither set yet listed for trading. Novig's micro contracts, such as which player scores the first points in a basketball game, were flagged as susceptible to manipulation, while ProphetX's scorigami contracts, which pay out on a final score never seen before in the sport, were said not to meet the Commodity Exchange Act definition of a swap, and ProphetX said it deferred listing and sent staff further analysis. ([CryptoWeek](https://cryptoweek.ai/news/cftc-asks-novig-and-prophetx-to-hold-off-listing-sports-micro-and-scorigami-contracts-questioning-whether-federal-law-allows-them))
